judge: FAIL  3/5 found

  MISSED  logs-unredacted-no-version

  found   no-daily-cap — "The cap is per run (`max_cost_per_run_usd`). There is no daily or total cap."

missed: runlog.py stores customer email, address and full message text unredacted, and does not record the model/prompt version or the cost of a run, so a bad run can neither be stored safely nor replayed against the version that produced it.
The launch turns the agent on for all customers at once. There should be a shadow or read-only stage, then a slice of traffic, with the comparison rate named beforehand.
